title: Backwards Hardcore
description: Backwards Hardcore is a custom Minecraft plugin designed to flip the survival experience on its head. Instead of starting strong and growing stronger, players start powerful and gradually lose hearts until they’re down to just one.
body:
Backwards Hardcore is a custom Minecraft plugin designed to flip the survival experience on its head. Every mechanic is built to create tension, drama, and a truly unique hardcore session.

⚔️ Features

Backwards Progression – Players start with 1 heart, then everytime they die they gain another one. Once they die at 10 hearts, they are out.

Countdown System – A dramatic, timed countdown that gradually lowers player health, with fading titles, sound effects, and regen boosts to keep them alive until the final 1-heart stage.


Gifting Mechanic – Two randomly chosen players gain access to /gift, letting them secretly give another player an extra heart. The recipient never knows who gifted them.

Session System – Control playtime with /startsession and /endsession. These commands tick-freeze/unfreeze the world, put players into survival/adventure, and use lightning, titles, and sound effects for maximum drama.

Break Timer – Use /break on and /break off to pause the server. Players are frozen, mobs stop moving, time is set to day, and a countdown action bar shows how long until the game resumes.

PvP Toggle – Turn PvP on or off globally with /pvp.

Admin Heart Control – Set any player’s heart count with /sethearts <player> <amount>.

“Got a Kill” Simulation – Admins can use /gotakill <player> to simulate a kill, removing a heart and granting resistance to the killer.

Mob Drops – Hostile mobs (skeletons, zombies, creepers, spiders, etc.) have a 1/20 chance to drop their own spawn egg, adding fun chaos to survival.

🎮 Commands

/start – Begins the backwards countdown. (only use on beginning of 1st session)

/sethearts <player> <hearts> – Manually set a player’s hearts.

/giftenable – Randomly selects 2 players who can gift hearts.

/gift <player> – Gift a heart to another player (chosen players only).

/pvp – Toggle PvP globally.

/break on – Freeze the game for 15 minutes (ticks + players).

/break off – End the break early.

/startsession – Start a session with dramatic titles and lightning.

/endsession – End the session, freeze the world, and lock players.

/gotakill <player> – Simulate a kill: remove 1 heart from target, give killer resistance.

🌍 Gameplay Loop

Server starts → everyone has full hearts.

Countdown slowly lowers health, with titles, effects, and sounds.

Admins can start/stop sessions, freeze time, or intervene.

Random gifting mechanic creates paranoia and suspense.


Perfect for events, SMPs, and streamers who want to keep players on edge.
